column1: # Level-1 audio route (issue #13): the shared scripted route from issue #8, plus the bar door.
# The first four legs are `level1-route.tsv`'s own rows, unchanged (spawn, cantina, street, door).
# The last two legs walk the bar's doorway at (-8, -5), where `01_SoundTrack.cog` links `onAdjoin`
# (surface 206, linkid 1) and `offAdjoin` (surface 213, linkid 0). Leaving the bar (sector 19) turns
# the redbook music up; coming back turns it down.
# Each door leg starts one step from the plane (0.005 units), so its crossing is the leg's **first
# walk tick** whatever the movement rule does — the fade's phase is then a property of the script,
# not of movement parity (issue #10). The warps in between stay on one side of the plane, so they
#   spawn        180  level 1's own start, the route's first leg (issue #8)
#   approach       6  a neutral pose: the level's own spawn, far from the door plane
#   bar_in       150  walk out of the bar: crossed linkid 1 arms the +0.05/0.1 s fade up
#   return         6  a neutral pose: the cantina placement, on the bar's own side
#   bar_out      150  walk back in: crossed linkid 0 arms the -0.1/0.1 s fade down
